item.title: HIGHLIGHTS: The No. 20 Lady Raiders get back on track after sweeping No. 15 Baylor
item.description: LUBBOCK, Texas (KMID/KPEJ) - No. 20 Texas Tech defeated No. 15 Baylor 87-56, improving to 24-4 on the season.
